items.title: Independent Gaussian rows and their truncated matrix images

source.anchor: Appendix C.2 p1 full row independence, p12 first sentence and Ex107 independent truncated matrices; S4.E11 half-grid, p10 cutoff and standing2q+1<d
source.attribution: On Complexity of Gaussian Sampling, arXiv:2610.20492v1.
source.scope: Joint independence in the concrete source column-product realization and actual measurable Ex107 images; no arbitrary ambient-space transfer.

items.statement: The coordinate-row vectors of the independent-column Gaussian experiment are jointly independent. Their actual truncated matrix images are measurable and jointly independent in that same experiment.

formulae.label: Actual measurable independent matrix family
formulae.tex: \forall i,\ Y_i\text{ is measurable};\qquad (Y_i)_{i=1}^d\text{ is independent under }\mu.

assumptions: Let \(d,q\in\mathbb N\), \(2q+1<d\), and \(r=q+1\). In particular \(d\ge2\), \(r\ge1\), and \(q=0\) is included.

Write \(\gamma_n=N(0,I_n)\) on real Euclidean \(n\)-space. The outcome space is \(\Omega=(\mathbb R^d)^r\), with the literal column-product probability law \(\mu=\gamma_d^{\otimes r}\). Define \(\Phi_i(\omega)=(\omega_{1,i},\ldots,\omega_{r,i})\in\mathbb R^r\).

The public independence conclusion means factorization for every finite family of Borel row events. The canonical row-law declaration supplies row measurability and Gaussian marginal laws internally; neither law nor independence is a caller-supplied certificate.

For the actual matrix consumer, put \(\theta_i=(i-\tfrac12)\pi/d\), \(t_i[0]=1\), \(t_i[k]=\sqrt2\cos(k\theta_i)\) for \(1\le k\le q\), and \(L=2r+3\log(1000d)\). Lean uses source indices \(i.val+1\) and \(a.val+1\).

Each \(Y_i\) has the displayed literal formula with its own closed cutoff. At entry \(((a,j),(b,k))\), the value inside the cutoff is \(d^{-1}\Phi_i[a]\Phi_i[b]t_i[j]t_i[k]\). Gaussian coordinates come first in both paired indices.

Matrices use their finite real-entry product measurable structure. Both measurability of all \(Y_i\) and full-family independence are proved outputs. The deterministic features vary with \(i\), so no identical-distribution claim for the matrices is made. No Gram, norm, moment, integrability, tail, \(\tau\), or condition-number premise is added.

obligations.label: Full coordinate-row independence with a real measurable independent Ex107 consumer.

bindings.boundary: This local result proves full row-family independence in the canonical independent-column realization and the complete private consumer proves measurability and independence of the actual source truncated matrices. The producer adds independence to the same existing canonical row-law node; it creates no second marginal-law proof. Arbitrary extended-ambient transfer, original matrix-expectation adapters, public aggregate canonicalization, centered variance, matrix concentration, full Lemma4.4, both main lower bounds and exact oracle/TV/precision/worst-query-cap/expected-cost adapters remain open. Serialized integration, actual desktop/mobile/source-index/globalgraph/copy/download/public delivery and purification remain open.
